verdict.rationale: React's first-party docs and README say you can build Android and iOS apps in React through React Native and Expo, with truly native UIs and React DevTools integration. This lets developers reuse their React skills on mobile. The capability depends on separate frameworks (React Native/Expo) rather than React alone, and the docs give no detail on sharing code between web and native or on mobile performance. Missing for 10: documentation of code reuse across web and native, evidence of mobile performance, independent hands-on corroboration, and native support without additional frameworks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reuse my framework skills and code to build performant native mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: React Native and Expo let you build apps in React for Android, iOS, and more. They look and feel native because their UIs are truly native.
power mobile apps using React Native
To inspect apps built with React Native, you can use React Native DevTools, the built-in debugger that deeply integrates React Developer Tools.
